svg.title: Union Vault daily settlement
svg.desc: Each day, validator rewards that flowed into the vault are settled. The staker allocation equals inflow times 60 percent times staked divided by cap, and is streamed to stakers over 24 hours. Everything else is burned to the dEaD address. Occupied seats earn; the yield attached to empty seats is burned.
svg.text: Validator rewards earned by the node
Each seat is paid for itself only — your APR does not depend on how many others join.
